description: This file defines the CandidateShortlistingAPI class within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It provides an API endpoint for shortlisting candidates, including API documentation via OpenAPI annotations. The class extends AbstractCandidateActionAPI and implements a method to get the resulting workflow state after a candidate is shortlisted.

classes.name: CandidateShortlistingAPI
classes.description: API class for candidate shortlisting within the recruitment module, providing an endpoint to shortlist candidates and specifying the resulting workflow state.

methods.name: getResultingState
methods.description: Returns the workflow state constant indicating the state after candidate is shortlisted.
